name: Avalon USDa
oneLiner: USDa is Avalon's BTC-backed CDP stablecoin with 1:1 USDT convertibility, leveraging institutional credit lines and proprietary HFT liquidation logic.
collateral: FBTC (tokenized BTC, Cobo-custodied) deposited as overcollateralized CDP; USDT/USDC can be deposited 1:1 (exempt from liquidation); protocol assets held with Cobo, Fireblocks, and Coinbase Prime custody and backed by multi-billion-dollar institutional balance sheets
pegMechanism: 1:1 USDT convertibility (redemptions require loan repayment or conversion to USDT); overcollateralized against FBTC priced by Redstone oracle; HFT liquidation algorithm sells collateral on centralized exchanges to restore target LTV; cross-chain via LayerZero OFT

oracleRisk.summary: Avalon USDa uses RedStone BTC-USD pricing for its FBTC-backed CeDeFi CDP, with governed LTV thresholds and an operational liquidation algorithm that sells collateral on centralized exchanges.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research
branchApplicability.rationale: USDa supports collateralized borrowing against FBTC with published maximum, liquidation, and recovery LTV parameters. Its CeDeFi account model and centralized-exchange liquidation differ from permissionless onchain auctions, but they still form a distinct collateral-price and liquidation branch that must be reviewed; 1:1 USDT and USDC deposits are documented as non-liquidatable conversion collateral.

branches.label: Avalon CeDeFi FBTC collateral
branches.summary: FBTC-backed USDa borrowing uses RedStone BTC-USD pricing, published LTV thresholds, and Avalon-operated centralized-exchange liquidation.

feeds.path: RedStone BTC-USD feed -> Avalon CeDeFi risk monitor -> account LTV

branches.fallbackBehavior: Avalon identifies RedStone as the primary BTC-USD oracle and continuous centralized-exchange monitoring, but the reviewed documentation does not name a secondary contractual feed or automatic onchain fallback.

collateralParameters.note: Avalon publishes a 90% liquidation LTV and an 80% recovery LTV for FBTC-backed positions; USDT and USDC deposits are listed as 100% max LTV and not subject to liquidation.

branches.liquidationMechanism: When an FBTC account exceeds the 90% liquidation LTV, withdrawals are restricted and Avalon sells part of the collateral on centralized exchanges through its high-frequency execution system until the account reaches the 80% recovery LTV.
branches.backstop: The reviewed USDa documentation describes collateral sale and institutional custody providers but does not identify a contractual reserve fund, insurance module, or permissionless recapitalization backstop for residual bad debt.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: The reviewed USDa materials do not document a global shutdown settlement or a contractual process for allocating losses that remain after centralized-exchange collateral liquidation.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Avalon metadata and external chain docs identify USDa as an omnichain/LayerZero OFT-style asset. Because durable supply can move through OFT messaging across many chains, the reviewed route is an external lock/mint/OFT route.

mintAuthority.summary: Ethereum USDa is an immutable AccessControl/OFT token with two current MINT_ROLE-holder proxies. Both minter ProxyAdmins and the token's ADMIN_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and owner resolve to the same 5-of-6 Safe, which can add minters, upgrade either minter proxy, and configure OFT peers.

upgradeability.controlRef: USDa token and minter-proxy admin Safe

controls.label: USDa MINT_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: A complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked replay plus hasRole() confirms this transparent proxy still holds MINT_ROLE at Ethereum block 25530438. Its EIP-1967 implementation is 0x10D162BB7fA363201b0c749cd96322082F733a97 and ProxyAdmin is 0x8ed73f9e5a4b49d07e696fe03b867e0870ac0e69, owned by the reviewed USDa Safe. The current implementation is not explorer-verified, so no narrower call-level cap is claimed.

controls.label: USDa MINT_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: A complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked replay plus hasRole() confirms this transparent proxy still holds MINT_ROLE at Ethereum block 25530438. Its EIP-1967 implementation is 0x1d6321C031665802b9829f60a0602364BF30456f and ProxyAdmin is 0x06de2c3fe2b69ad0acfe2aeccc871f327b08d093, owned by the reviewed USDa Safe. The current implementation is not explorer-verified, so no narrower call-level cap is claimed.

controls.label: USDa token and minter-proxy admin Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530438, owner() returned this Safe and hasRole() confirmed it holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and ADMIN_ROLE. Both minter ProxyAdmin owner() calls also returned this Safe. RPC and Safe Transaction Service reported threshold 5, six owners, no modules, and zero guard. It can grant MINT_ROLE, upgrade either existing minter proxy, and configure trusted OFT peers.

review.evidence: Complete Ethereum role-event replay through block 25530438 identifies exactly two live MINT_ROLE holders and the sole current admin Safe. Direct storage and owner() reads establish both transparent-proxy minter implementations, their two ProxyAdmins, and common 5-of-6 Safe ownership. The immutable USDa token also uses LayerZero OFT peer minting; deployment route semantics remain separately represented by bridgeRouteRisk rather than duplicated as an unidentified mint control.

reserves.name: FBTC-backed CDP positions and USDT/USDC 1:1 mint reserves

reserveReview.rationale: Avalon verifies FBTC-backed borrowing plus 1:1 USDT minting and identifies USDC as a supported non-liquidating collateral, but publishes no current supply-weighted composition. The prior 45/40/15 split and USDT edge were estimates, so the reviewed fallback retains one conservative basket without fabricating dependency weights.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Officially documented issuance and collateral paths; constituent shares are undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Avalon does not publish the current proportions of FBTC-backed debt, USDT deposits, and USDC deposits.
